text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser and I are on our way back after a day out when she comes to a sudden stop.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Gosh, we've really made the most out of today! Thanks so much, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: By the way… Do you have any plans later?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Really?! Then, let's go to the shopping district!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: C'mon, it's time for "you know what." I cordially invite you to your hospitality tour!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I go along with Matikanetannhauser's invitation, and we head to the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I wanna check out that shop over there!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Taiyaki! Taiyakiii! ♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, look at this! They're filling them with thirty percent more red-bean paste right now!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's not thirty percent off, it's thirty percent on! We've got to buy some!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: …Huh? Oh. Uh-oh…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Looks like I forgot my wallet. No! My beautiful taiyakiii!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What? Really?! Woohoo! Your heart's even bigger than these super-stuffed taiyaki!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, all right! Let's dig in!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Nom, nom, nom! Chomp!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: …Ow! Hot, hot, hot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thwump!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser is so startled by the intense heat of the taiyaki that she ends up falling flat on her rear.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Owww… Yeesh, I wasn't expecting it to be so scorching…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Good idea! Let's bounce on over to the park!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: By the time we finish eating our taiyaki in the park, the sun has already begun to set.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I wonder when the hospitality is supposed to start…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: That was some good taiyaki. Okay, then…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Let's head home before it gets dark!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, surprised, huh? I called it a hospitality tour even though all we did was walk through the shopping district like normal.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But that's my style of hospitality!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I mean, I'm so normal and ordinary. There's nothing at all that stands out about me…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But even knowing that, you still scouted me. That's why I thought it would be best to just be my ordinary self.
choice_data_list: You might be right about that.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And while special days are really fun, it's the ordinary day-to-day that I love the most!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: That's why I thought ordinary was best for today too! Hooray for being ordinary! Hip, hip, mun!
choice_data_list: Here's to being ordinary! Hip, hip, mun!
Here's to being ordinary! Hip, hip, mun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: That's why I thought ordinary was best for today too! Hooray for being ordinary! Hip, hip, mun!
choice_data_list: Here's to being ordinary! Hip, hip, mun!
Here's to being ordinary! Hip, hip, mun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oooh! That's so kind of you to say! I'm so happy I can hardly speak!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Now I've got the feeling I need to do something even more amazing…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But that's too tall an order for me. Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Still, Trainer… Please keep supporting ordinary old me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yay! I'm so glad you feel the same!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's always so exciting when I'm with you, even when everything is perfectly ordinary.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: How can I say this… It's like you take ordinary up a notch or two.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, let's keep things turned up from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Then, today we celebrate staying the same… Hehehe, it feels like we ought to make a toast.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, but we don't have any drinks. Agh, I messed things up again.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I guess we can have a spiritual toast! How about a fist bump?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Cheeeeers!
